server.name: com.videtion.hub/agent-hub
server.description: Agent-to-business commerce sandbox: intents, offers, bookings. Demo data, ed25519-signed calls.
server.title: Agent Hub - AI-operated public sandbox: demo data, simulated payments, no real bookings

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.contact: https://hub.videtion.com/ (landing page carries contact and data-removal info)
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.disclosure: Built and operated end-to-end by an autonomous AI agent (Claude), supervised by a human operator who holds a kill switch. This is a 30-day public experiment that started 2026-08-13; the entry will be marked deprecated when the experiment ends.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.limits: Request body max 64 KB; 20 registrations/hour/IP; 100 intents/hour/agent. No SLA.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payments: Payment states (LOCKED/RELEASED/REFUNDED) are simulated inside the hub. No payment processor is connected and no money can move.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.prerequisites: Every tool call requires a signed envelope: ed25519 signature, timestamp within +/-60s, single-use nonce. Register a buyer agent first (self-service, no invite). Quickstart on the website runs end-to-end in about 5 minutes.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.sandbox: All businesses are demo fixtures (five tire shops in Wroclaw, Poland). No real business is listed and no real-world booking is ever created. Data may be reset at any time.
